unit: Algebra · Chapter 4. Continuity and the derivative
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: If the distance is s(t), the average velocity on [t; t + Δt] is Δs/Δt and the instantaneous velocity is its limit as Δt → 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the distance is s(t), the average velocity on [t; t + Δt] is Δs/Δt and the instantaneous velocity is its limit as Δt → 0.

stages.headline: Example: s(t) = t². Δs = 2tΔt + Δt², Δs/Δt = 2t + Δt → 2t, so v(t) = 2t.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: s(t) = t². Δs = 2tΔt + Δt², Δs/Δt = 2t + Δt → 2t, so v(t) = 2t.

stages.headline: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity: a(t) = lim Δv/Δt; for s(t) = t², v = 2t and a = 2.
stages.headlineEnglish: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity: a(t) = lim Δv/Δt; for s(t) = t², v = 2t and a = 2.
